notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Dockside Chef by paying {1}{B} and sacrificing a creature.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Dockside Chef ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
